notes.tiers: DG-8. floor: never waivable. reflex: waivable on the record only, by a waiver whose evidence (a file and the exact text) designcheck.py re-checks against the rule and whose reason names the page; boilerplate, page-free or copied reasons are rejected and the finding stays. finish: answered in the report, never blocking.
notes.registry: DG-10. Rules marked tell are a dated registry of template tells: status flagged, warned or retired; basis measured, taste or brand. A tell is listed, not flagged, when the brief asks for that look (brief_terms: every word of one group appears in the brief). A message says what was found and never names a replacement font or colour.
notes.suppressions: DG-13. In source, a comment `designcheck: ignore <rule or code> value=<the value> by=<who> because <evidence>` silences that one value. An agent may add only these. `designcheck: ignore-rule <rule> by=user turn=<the user's turn> because <evidence>` (rule-wide in one file) and `designcheck: ignore-file by=user turn=<turn> because <evidence>` need the user's decision; without by=user and a turn they are findings and silence nothing. Every applied ignore is listed in the report (DG-12).
notes.examples: Each rule carries must_match and must_not_match examples in the shape of the core's scripts/ruletest.py; designcheck.py refuses the whole file when one rule disagrees with its own examples.
notes.shared_kinds: regex: the pattern over source with comments blanked. colour-pair: one colour in each named band anywhere in a file. card-chrome: card selectors sharing one border-radius and one box-shadow, counted against the threshold. gradient-hue: a CSS gradient with a stop in each band, or a class list with both from- and to- classes. font-size-min: a font-size below the threshold.

rules.message: a form that posts nowhere (no action and no submit handler) shows success text: never print success for a submission that goes nowhere
must_match: Thanks, you're on the list!
must_not_match: Thanks, you're on the list!

rules.message: a statistic with no recorded source: give it data-source naming where the number comes from, or make it a labelled slot such as [metric: active teams]; never invent a figure
must_not_match: 10,000+ teams ship with it

rules.message: placeholder copy in a built page: use the client's real content, or a labelled slot that says what is missing
must_not_match: Invoices reconcile against the bank feed every night.

rules.message: the empty state is tested before the pending state, so the empty sentence shows while data is still loading, which says something false: branch pending, then error, then empty, then rows
must_match:
if (rows.length === 0) return <Empty text="No invoices yet" />;
if (isLoading) return null;

rules.message: a pixel value derived from a token or breakpoint is hardcoded: measure the drawn element or read the token, since a changed root size or token leaves the number wrong
a hover changes the target's box (size, spacing or scale): hover may change colour and opacity only; a recorded exception goes through a waiver
rules.source: web-physics-animation.md:182-183 (the brief's F2, a hover test where 31 of 76 hovers shifted); emilkowalski/skills skills/review-animations/STANDARDS.md:160-169

rules.message: a layout read or a framework state update runs every animation frame: read layout once, animate transform and opacity, and pause work offscreen
must_match: function tick() { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.style.left = r.x + 1 + 'px'; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
must_not_match:
const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
function tick() { x += 1; el.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)'; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }

rules.message: a correctness rule, not project policy: easing toward a target by a fixed fraction every animation frame settles faster on faster screens; scale it by elapsed time (a = 1 - exp(-k * dt), dt clamped) and keep springs for motion whose inertia is the point
rules.source: scottstts/Threejs-Awesome-Graphics-Agent-Skills@53eb5a24 skills/threejs-procedural-animation/references/procedural-motion-and-docking-systems.md:314-333, :341 (ideas only; the pack ships GPL-3.0 material)
must_match: function tick() { x += (target - x) * 0.1; el.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)'; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
must_not_match: function tick(now) { const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1); last = now; const a = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 8); x += (target - x) * a; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }

rules.message: an easing that overshoots its end (a cubic-bezier outside 0 to 1, a spring with bounce, a back or elastic curve), and the project's motion policy says never
an element scales, and the project's motion policy says never outside its recorded exceptions
an element follows the pointer, and the project's motion policy says never
a section holding only a heading and one paragraph: a page that passes every ban can still be thin; give it real substance or fold it into another section

Security

Keys never leave your account.

one radius and one shadow on every card, a template tell; vary the treatment by what each card holds unless the brief asks for uniform cards
an uppercase eyebrow label above a heading, a template tell
